title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Updated Red Hat OpenStack Platform 17.1 director Operator container images
description: A vulnerability in the Go crypto/x509 package used by Red Hat OpenStack Platform 17.1 director Operator container images allows man-in-the-middle attacks via untrusted intermediate certificates. The certificate verification process fails to block trust in intermediate certificates associated with compromised Certificate Authorities, enabling attackers to impersonate legitimate servers during secure connections. Updated container images have been released to address this issue.
